title: PVP: An Image Dataset for Personalized Visual Persuasion with Persuasion Strategies, Viewer Characteristics, and Persuasiveness Ratings
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates Moral Foundations Theory (MFQ-30) as a core metric for evaluating and benchmarking how human moral values (care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and sanctity) influence the persuasiveness of visual content, and it evaluates model performance against these moral characteristics.
